recipe.title: Easy Chicken, Kielbasa and Shrimp Paella
recipe.instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat. Add the rice and cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Stir the broth, picante sauce and turmeric in the skillet and heat to a boil. Reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 15 minutes.
  2. Stir the kielbasa, shrimp and chicken in the skillet. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the rice is tender.
recipe.summary: If you have roughly 45 minutes to spend in the kitchen, Easy Chicken, Kielbasan and Shrimp Paella might be a great gluten free and dairy free recipe to try. For $2.94 per serving, you get a main course that serves 8. One serving contains 385 calories, 33g of protein, and 9g of fat. It is a budget friendly recipe for fans of European food. This recipe is liked by 19 foodies and cooks. A mixture of regular rice, picante sauce, shrimp, and a handful of other ingredients are all it takes to make this recipe so tasty. It is brought to you by Foodista. With a spoonacular score of 69%, this dish is solid. Try Easy Shrimp and Chicken Paella, Shrimp and Scallop Easy Paella, and Chicken and Shrimp Paella for similar recipes.
ingredients: 1 package (about 10 ounces) refrigerated fully-cooked chicken breast strips (about 1 3/4 cups)
4 cups Swanson® Chicken Broth or Swanson® Chicken Stock, heated
2 cups uncooked regular long-grain white rice
3/4 pound small frozen peeled, deveined, cooked shrimp, thawed
